# LittlePings

> LittlePings is a free, safe, and fun keyboard-smashing toy for babies and toddlers aged 0–5. Every key press creates colourful animated emoji bubbles and plays a delightful piano-like ping sound. No ads, no accounts, no data collected — just pure toddler joy.

## What is LittlePings?

LittlePings turns keyboard smashing into a safe, screen-time-friendly activity for young children. It runs entirely in the browser as a Progressive Web App (PWA) — no installation required. Toddlers can smash any key and see colourful bubbles pop up on screen with satisfying sounds.

## Features

- Colourful animated emoji bubbles on every key press
- Playful piano-like ping sounds using the Web Audio API
- 6 beautiful colour themes: Candy, Ocean, Jungle, Space, Sunset, Arctic
- Key smash counter with milestone confetti at 100, 500, 1000, and 2000 smashes
- Parent lock — tap any corner 5 times to lock the app, PIN to unlock
- Idle attract screen and session summary screen
- Works on desktop, tablet, and mobile (tap to create bubbles on touchscreen)
- Progressive Web App — install to home screen, works fully offline
- 100% free, zero ads, zero data collected, zero accounts required
- Safe for kids — no external links, no tracking, no cookies

## Who is it for?

LittlePings is designed for:
- Babies and toddlers aged 0–5 years
- Parents who want a safe, ad-free digital toy
- Caregivers and educators looking for a stimulating sensory activity

## Technology

- React 19 + TypeScript
- Vite 5 + vite-plugin-pwa
- Tailwind CSS + Framer Motion
- Web Audio API (no external audio files)
- Cloudflare Pages (CDN, SSL, global edge)
